name: What should I consider before starting an interior framing project?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before starting an interior framing project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting an interior framing project, consider your desired floor plan, budget, and timeline. Gather any existing architectural drawings, and think about the placement of doors, windows, and built-in features. It's also important to have a clear understanding of your needs for electrical outlets, lighting, and plumbing, as these will influence the framing layout. A detailed plan upfront helps streamline the process and ensures the finished space meets your functional and aesthetic goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before interior framing, consider your desired floor plan, budget, timeline, and needs for doors, windows, electrical, and plumbing.
